title: Marketplace publish preflight: field guide (WIP)
content:
Goal:
- Create a compact field guide for engineering, product and partner teams to get a listing from draft -> published on major cloud marketplaces (AWS, Azure, GCP) with minimum rework. This doc is intentionally pragmatic: copy snippets + acceptance tests + who to call during last-mile issues.

Quick context / audience:
- Primary: GTM program managers, partner engineers, partner success.
- Secondary: Legal for contract hooks, infra for entitlement/telemetry, docs for public copy.

High-level publish steps (one-liner):
1) Confirm partner legal & SKU model (billing contract ready)
2) Finalize listing copy + tile assets
3) Validate technical integration (entitlements, trial provisioning, SaaS connector endpoints)
4) Run smoke tests across cloud marketplaces + telemetry validation
5) Submit listing, monitor first 48h, triage rollout issues

Acceptance checklist (preflight items to tick off before 'submit'):
- Business/legal:
  - Billing SKU assigned and mapping doc uploaded (owner: finance ops)
  - Partner contract includes data residency and KMS clause where required
  - Trial entitlements and crediting policy signed off

- Copy & creative:
  - Hero tile headline (<= 50 chars) and 1-line subtitle approved
  - 300–500 word short description + 3 bullets of core benefits (see copy snippets below)
  - 2 tile image variants (16:9 and square), SVG logo, white/transparent backgrounds
  - Localization plan (EN + priority locales) and i18n owner assigned

- Technical & security:
  - API contract for provisioning endpoint documented: /v1/marketplace/provision (spec link in linked_artifacts)
  - Entitlement mapping table completed (marketplace SKU -> Redwood product_id)
  - SSO/OAuth flow tested (if required) and callback whitelists provided to vendor portals
  - Minimal security checklist: TLS certs, public key pinning where relevant, pentest summary attached

- Observability & telemetry:
  - Events instrumented for: install.provisioned, install.failed, trial.started, trial.expired, seat.allocated
  - Telemetry includes partner_id and marketplace_source tags
  - Metric dashboards created: daily installs, successful provisioning rate, latency P95 for provisioning endpoint

- Ops + rollout plan:
  - Support playbook (triage doc + escalation matrix) created and copied to partner success
  - Canary window and blocking criteria defined (e.g., >5% provisioning failures in 1h -> rollback)
  - Rollout owner (on-call) identified for first 72 hours post-publish

Copy snippets (starter kit — keep short, factual, testable):
- Headline (tile): "Redwood Inference — Low-latency LLM inference"
- Subtitle: "Predictable throughput, flexible deployments — Hosted, Dedicated, Private"
- Short description (300 chars): "Serve LLMs with predictable latency and optimized cost. Redwood Inference delivers a unified runtime across hosted, reserved and private deployments with built-in observability and rollouts. Start a trial or connect your infra in minutes."
- 3 benefit bullets:
  1) "Consistent performance across deployment modes — hosted API to private VPC."
  2) "Cost controls: batching, cache, and quantization recommendations tied to usage."
  3) "Production-grade SLAs, telemetry, and automated fallbacks to avoid outages."

Example technical acceptance tests (smoke):
- Provisioning flow: POST /v1/marketplace/provision -> 201 within 3s; verify returned entitlement token resolves to active customer record
- Trial start: Trigger trial via marketplace UI -> event trial.started emitted within 10s and visible in partner dashboard
- Token validation: Attempt to call inference endpoint with provisioning token -> 200 and sample generation within latency SLO (P95 < 300ms for short prompts)
- Failure modes: Simulate over-quota and confirm fallback model variant is served and error code + telemetry emitted

Edge cases & gotchas (notes from prior marketplace onboards):
- Marketplace billing often changes SKU naming — always include human-readable mapping column in the sheet (avoid relying on numeric IDs alone)
- Some marketplaces require a separate registration for private offers — schedule legal sign-off early
- Timezone issues: trials and credit windows are interpreted in vendor local time; clarify in partner docs
- Rate-limit spikes during initial listing day (marketing traffic): provision burst capacity or set feature flags to limit heavy paths

Operational runbook snippets (copy these into the support playbook):
- Symptom: provisioning failures >=5% for 30m -> immediate rollback to previous provisioning webhook and open incident (pager: eng-oncall)
- Symptom: installs succeed but telemetry absent -> verify webhook signing secret rotated? check ingestion lambda logs
- Symptom: fraud/spam installs -> throttle region and escalate to security with list of install IPs

Who to ping (Quick contacts):
- Partner success: Priya Patel (priya@redwood.com)
- Marketplace PM (internal): Maya Singh (maya@redwood.com)
- Platform infra contact (entitlements): Jonah Rivera (jonah@redwood.com)
- Oncall escalation: eng-oncall@redwood.com

Unresolved questions (to be discussed in async thread):
- Do we require HSM-backed keys for all private-deployment listings or only for enterprise SKUs? (blocking for AWS Private Offer)
- Standardized naming convention for SKU -> product_id across cloud portals (propose: marketplaceName_productSlug_v1)

Next immediate actions (owner + ETA):
- [Jonah] Finalize entitlement mapping sheet and upload to linked artifacts (ETA: 2024-11-22)
- [Maya] Confirm tile creatives size variants and provide final assets (ETA: 2024-11-27)
- [Priya] Draft support playbook with escalation ladder and sample Slack templates (ETA: 2024-12-01)

Notes to self / brainstorming fragments:
- Consider offering a "light" SKU for SMBs with limited API concurrency but cheaper unit costs to drive trial conversions
- Could experiment with an "in-market" badge for listings that pass our benchmark latency tests (marketing + trust)
- Track first-week conversion by channel (marketplace tile vs direct sign-up) to validate traffic quality

References and templates (copy links into final folder):
- Marketplace tile copy template (doc): https://confluence.redwood.com/display/GTM/Tile+Copy+Template
- Entitlement mapping template (sheet): https://sheets.redwood.com/marketplace-entitlements-template
- Previous publish postmortem (aws private offer hiccup): https://confluence.redwood.com/display/GTM/AWS+PO+Postmortem
